entities.name: Pərviz Bağırov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Parviz Baghirov is an Azerbaijani boxer. He competed in the men's welterweight event at the 2016 Summer Olympics. He won the gold medal at the 2015 European Games and a bronze medal at the 2015 World Boxing Championships.
